verdict.rationale: JumpCloud publishes an llms.txt at jumpcloud.com/llms.txt, so an agent has a documented entry point (jumpcloud-docs-14). However, the quoted content is a marketing-style platform overview, and probes show no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI file at the expected docs.jumpcloud.com paths. A machine-readable API spec does exist at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml (jumpcloud-docs-25). missing for 10: llms.txt on the docs site, agent-oriented or markdown versions of the product and API docs, evidence that the llms.txt links to technical docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
